notes: Bridge 423 gate fires before authentication — even unpaired requests get 423 when vault is locked
App displays raw 'HTTP 423: {"error": "vault_locked", ...}' as error text (BridgeError.Unknown catch-all in UserMessages.forBridgeError)
No dedicated 423 handler in BridgeClient.execute() — falls through to else -> BridgeError.Unknown(code, body)
UX improvement opportunity: add BridgeError.VaultLocked type and show 'Vault is locked' message instead of raw HTTP error
Security property holds: no clip data is accessible when vault is locked, regardless of pairing state
